conditions.policy: use finite 61-day support; reproduce frozen baseline
use 61 when sufficient for the native class; otherwise require sufficient 31 support and full calendar window inside the same frozen activity interior
use finite 61-day support only when its full calendar window lies inside the same frozen activity interior

class_support.steady_motion: finite velocity vector; no new claim that availability establishes nonzero steady motion
class_support.acceleration_or_deceleration: finite velocity and tangential acceleration from the same selected window

unknown_native_policy: preserve unknown; never infer a stage from available derivatives
outside_activity_or_missing_policy: preserve frozen labels; no definite stages
raw_sign_conflict_policy: diagnostic only; no sign-based reclassification or conflict veto
input_identity_checks: match complete dates, observation hash, activity content hash and observation-only diagnostics before using native outputs
primary_denominator: all 585 observed definite reference stage days, retaining prediction unknown and failure
full_activity_denominator: all 2126 observed frozen activity days; report availability and output coverage without accuracy claims
reference_unknown_policy: report definite predictions on 1541 unknown-reference days separately, never treat them as false positives
reporting: all methods and conditions; correct, incorrect, abstained, per-class confusion and macro-F1 when all reference classes exist; per-record and per-interior changes; no best-arm replacement decision
